intro.summary: St. Dominic Savio was a young Italian student of St. John Bosco, remembered for his joyful holiness and devotion to the Eucharist and Mary.

blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Dear Saint Dominic Savio, you grew under the supervision and care of Saint John Bosco. Witnessing the zeal of your mentor, you shared his desire to bring the Lord a great many souls. Despite your frail and weak constitution, you devoutly waited for Holy Mass, kneeling outside your church until the doors opened, despite rain or snow. I pray with the words that you used: O Mary, I give you my heart. Grant me to be always yours. Jesus and Mary, be ever my friends, and, for love of you, grant me to die a thousand deaths rather than to have the misfortune of committing a single mortal sin. Amen. Jesus always spoke of his love for children, and we know that your requests will be well received. We humbly ask that you bring our petitions before the Lord

Saint Dominic Savio, pray for us. O Saint Dominic Savio, a model of purity, piety, penance, and apostolic zeal for youth; grant that, through your intercession, we may serve God in our ordinary duties with fervent devotion, and attain the grace of holy joy on earth, that we may one day love God forever in Heaven. Amen. In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
